statements.impact_statement: All 22 scanner matches are the literal guard strings 'pk_test_placeholder' and 'pk_live_placeholder' used in src/lib/stripe.ts:77 to detect an unconfigured VITE_STRIPE_PK at build time, and the same strings baked into the prerendered bundle static/assets/index-BoMLkOML.js. No real Stripe publishable key (pk_live_* or pk_test_* with credential material) is present in source, git history, or build output (verified via grep for pk_(live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,} -> 0 hits). The matches in .omo/panel-gpt5.stdout are in a gitignored, untracked tooling directory that is not shipped. Stripe publishable keys are public-by-design per Stripe's own key model. No credential exposure exists.
statements.action_statement: No action required. This VEX statement exists so `trivy fs --vex reports/2026-08/vex/VULN-202608-002.vex.json` suppresses the 22 placeholder matches in future monthly scans automatically, keeping the backlog signal-to-noise ratio high.
